description: This file implements the Administrator class within the WPEFramework RPC namespace, managing proxies, stubs, and communication channels for remote procedure calls. It handles reference counting, proxy creation, interface registration, and channel cleanup.

classes.name: Administrator
classes.description: Manages RPC proxies, stubs, and channels, providing methods for interface registration, reference counting, proxy creation, and cleanup.

methods.name: ~Administrator
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up proxies and stubs.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of Administrator.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments reference count for an interface and registers it.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements reference count for an interface and unregisters it.

methods.name: UnregisterUnknownProxy
methods.description: Removes a proxy from internal maps.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles invocation of a method on a remote interface.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates if an implementation instance is associated with a given interface ID.

methods.name: ProxyFind
methods.description: Finds a proxy for a given channel, implementation, and interface ID.

methods.name: ProxyInstance
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a proxy instance for a given channel, implementation, and interface ID.

methods.name: RegisterUnknownInterface
methods.description: Registers an interface with a channel for remote communication.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts a raw implementation pointer to a Core::IUnknown pointer based on interface ID.

methods.name: DeleteChannel
methods.description: Removes all proxies and references associated with a channel.
